title: Check whether RVO keeps older releases online
description: Search rvo.nl and the Wayback Machine for pre-August-2026 lists. Outcome recorded in AGENTS.md: history available from date X, or none. Decides how far back the history endpoint can go.
notes:
Rutger confirms the simplest current-data-only public v1 on 2026-09-07. History stays a later extension. No speculative paid-tier machinery or glossary extraction in v1. Implementation remains paused.
2026-11-01 evidence: the August 2026 heat-pump workbook URL still returns 200 and its SHA-256 (1e976b34...) matches the archived file, so RVO keeps older releases online (at least about 3 months).
2026-11-03 result: RVO deletes some old releases. Lost: 2025-02 and 2025-06 (8 xlsx URLs return 404, no Wayback copy). Wayback-only: 2025-05 insulation and solar boilers. Still online at RVO: 2025-09 to 2026-10 (gaps: heat pumps 2025-12, only ventilation in 2026-01, insulation 2026-04). Before 2025 the lists were PDF. Ventilation starts 2026-01. Nothing found for 2025-01, 03, 04, 07, 08; the RVO probe used the usual file name pattern only, a second probe with more name variants did not run (a harness safety check blocked the command). All 47 recovered workbooks are in the buckland raw archive (data/raw, 62 files total, hashes verified, restic-backed) and mirrored to anduril ~/.local/share/isde-api/raw-archive. Parser compatibility: insulation and solar boilers parse from 2025-05; glass and heat pumps only from 2026-02 (older headers differ); ventilation from 2026-02. Header differences in AGENTS.md. So a history endpoint can start at 2026-02 for all five categories without parser work, or at 2025-05 with per-period layouts.
Correction 2026-11-03: the recovered files are NOT yet in a restic snapshot; the 02:00 snapshot of 2026-11-03 predates the copy. The daily backup (hass-backup.timer, 02:00) of 2026-11-04 is the first that can include them. Docs merged in PR #8 (4d20a6b). Pre-change metadata backup: buckland ~/backups/isde-raw-metadata-2026-11-03.tar.gz.
2026-11-03 (Rutger approved via Roost, open item 1): submitted the 40 older workbook URLs (2025-09 to 2026-07, without 2026-05) to web.archive.org/save. All 40 requests returned 302; Wayback CDX lists a 200 capture dated 2026-11-03 for all 40 (16 appeared only after about 30 minutes of index lag).

title: Move the isde-api deploy from host Compose to k3s (Flux GitRepository, like ancestors)
description:
The service runs as a Docker Compose stack in /home/rdeknijf/services/isde-api on the Buckland host, behind the host Traefik front door, with a host cron entry for the daily import (see README.md and STATUS.md). Every other product in rdeknijf/square deploys through Flux on k3s from its own repo (causa, ancestors: a GitRepository with a read-only deploy key, a Kustomization CR in clusters/buckland/flux/, manifests under deploy/buckland in the product repo).

Scope when picked up: own namespace `isde-api`, a PVC for the SQLite file and the raw archive under /data, a CronJob for the daily import replacing the host crontab entry, the ingress through the k3s ingress path and Authentik is NOT in front (public API), image built by a build.yml in this repo to ghcr.io/rdeknijf/isde-api, a third read-only deploy key sealed in square. Cut over the Cloudflare CNAME target only after the k3s service answers /health with the same record count. Remove the host stack and the crontab entry afterwards; the previous crontab is saved on the host as crontab.before-isde.

Square-side notes: rdeknijf/square docs/isde-api.md. Not urgent: the host deploy works and is verified daily.
